mission: Merge all historical DreamCo bot and system sources into one governed architecture by deduplicating identities/content, assigning canonical owners, preserving provenance, and routing every usable worker through Buddy's shared runtime and sandbox stack.

merge_policy.canonical_bot_identity: App_bots remains authoritative for the existing 1,051 baseline.
merge_policy.missing_historical_bot: Expose as supplemental recovered worker until it passes promotion requirements.
merge_policy.same_slug: Merge capabilities/provenance into the canonical identity; never create a duplicate runtime identity.
merge_policy.same_normalized_name: Send to merge review before promotion.
merge_policy.same_content_hash: Represent once in the unified asset catalog with all source locations preserved.
merge_policy.legacy_system: Assign a canonical system owner and connect by adapter/reference rather than copying another parallel implementation.
merge_policy.legacy_note_or_spec: Link to its owner system as historical design evidence; do not treat notes as executable proof.
merge_policy.binary_asset: Preserve as an asset and attach provenance; do not turn it into a bot unless structured metadata proves that role.

truth_rule: One system means one governed source-of-truth map and runtime, not deleting historical evidence. Legacy source files remain preserved until reviewed migration proves they are safely redundant.
